designReversalHandling: F2a/F2c/F9/F10 were NOT re-filed as regressions. The delta deletes validateNoNewDeprecatedWorkloadTypes and restores the whole-object check, which is documented consistently as fresh-install-only, so those denials are unreachable under the stated premise. The summary says so explicitly and points at inline #1 as the reason it matters: the premise is unenforced.

followUps.what: Working preflight prototype, plus a correction that makes the ask smaller.
corrections: Withdrew the recommendation to build a Go preflight binary / extend the controller image. GetWorkloadType() only reads the role annotation and defaults to RoleInstanceSet -- there is no defaulting chain to reimplement -- so the check is a few lines of jq in the existing tools/crd-upgrade shape.
preempted: status.storedVersions as a simpler substitute: it is the wrong axis for R3-F22. The workload type is a role annotation, independent of the stored API version, so a v1alpha2 object carrying apps/v1/StatefulSet is invisible to it. It does work for the pre-alpha.3 upgrade gate, subject to its stickiness.

Each now opens with an explicit 'Edited' note naming what changed; GitHub preserves the edit history.
